English: We examine long-term retention of adults, adolescents and children on antiretroviral therapy under different HIV treatment guidelines in Malawi.

Yoruba: A ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìní ìṣètò ọlọ́jọ́ gbọọrọ ti àwọn àgbà, ọ̀dọ́ àti ọmọdé lórí i Ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ Fáírọ́sì-Àǹtìrítíró lábẹ́ ẹ oríṣi ìlàkalẹ̀ ìtọ́jú HIV mìíràn ní Malawi.
Zulu: Izinjongo Sihlola ukugcinwa kwesikhathi eside kwabantu abadala, intsha kanye nezingane ekwelashweni ngezidambisigciwane ngaphansi kwemihlahlandlela ehlukene yokwelashwa kwe-HIV e-Malawi.
Hausa: Maƙasudi Muna nazarin tsaywa na dogon lokaci na manya da matasa da kuma yara a kan maganin cutar ƙanjamau a ƙarƙashin jagororin jiyya na cutar HIV daban-daban a ƙasar Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Re lekola go tšwela pele ga lebaka le letelele le batho ba bagolo, bafsa ba mahlalagading le bana go kalafo ka dianthiretherobaerale ka fase ga ditlhahli tše di fapanego tša kalafo ya HIV ka Malawi.

English: Setting and participants Adults and children starting ART between 2005 and 2015 in 21 health facilities in southern Malawi.
Luganda: Ekifo n’abeetabi: Abantu abakulu n’abaana abaatandika obujjanjabi bwa ART wakati w’omwaka gwa 2005 ne 2015 mu malwaliro 21 agasangibwa mu bukiikaddyo bwa Malawi.
Yoruba: Ibùdó àti olùkópa Àwọn àgbà àti ọmọdé bẹ̀rẹ̀ ART láàárín 2005 àti 2015 ní ibùdó ìlera 21 ní gúsù Malawi.
Zulu: Ukubeka kanye nabahlanganyeli Abantu abadala kanye nezingane abaqala imishanguzo yesifo sengculaza phakathi kowe-2005 nowe-2015 ezikhungweni zezempilo ezingama-21 eningizimu yeMalawi.
Hausa: Wuri da masu shiga bincike Manya da yara da suka fara ART a tsakanin shekarar 2005 zuwa 2015 a cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya guda 21 a kudancin ƙasar Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Tikologo le bakgathatema Batho ba bagolo le bana bao ba thomišago ka ART magareng ga 2005 le 2015 ka mafelong a maphelo a 21 ka borwa bja Malawi.

English: We used survival analysis to assess retention at clinic level, Cox regression to examine risk factors for loss to follow up, and competing risk analysis to assess long-term outcomes of people on antiretroviral therapy (ART).
Luganda: Twakozesa okwekaliriza nnakiseera olw’okwekenneenya abalwadde abakyali ku ddagala ku kalwaliro, enkola ya Cox regression okwekenneenya ensonga z’obulabe ez’okufiirwa okulondoola, n’okwekenneenya kw’obulabe obuvuganya okusobola okwekaliriza ebivaamu eby’ekiseera ekiwanvu ku bantu abakozesa eddagala erikkakkanya ku Mukenenya (ART).
Yoruba: A lo ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ìwàláàyè láti lè ní ayè sí ìní ní ipele àyẹ̀wò, àwòṣe oníisrò Cox láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò sí ewu fún ìpàdánù oníkànsí, àti ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ewu onítakora láti ní àǹfààní sí àbájáde ọjọ́ iwájú àwọn ènìyàn lórí i Ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ Fáírọ́sì-Àǹtìrítíró (ART).
Zulu: Sisebenzise ukuhlaziya ukusinda ukuze sihlole ukugcinwa ezingeni lasemtholampilo, i-Cox regression ukuze sihlole izici eziyingozi zokulahlekelwa okufanele zilandelwe, kanye nokuhlaziya ubungozi obuqhudelanayo ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela yesikhathi eside yabantu abasebenzisa imishanguzo yegciwane lengculazi (ART).
Hausa: Hanyoyi Mun yi amfani da bincike na rayuwa domin tantance tsayawa a matakin asibiti, Ƙididdigar hasashe domin nazarin abubuwan haɗari domin asarar da za a biyo baya, da kuma nazarin haɗarin gasa domin tantance sakamakon dogon lokaci na mutanen da suke kan maganin ƙanjamau (ART).
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše tshekatsheko ya go phologa go sekaseka go tšwela pele ka balwetšo maemo a ka dikliniking, mokgwa wa poelomorago wa Cox o dirišitšwe go lekola mabaka a kotsi a tahlegelo ao re ka a latišišago, le go dira tshekatsheko ya dikotsi go lekola dipoelo tša lebaka le letelele tša batho bao ba lego go kalago ka dianthiretherobaerale (ART).
Amharic: በክሊኒክ ደረጃ ማቆየትን ለመገምገም፣ የኮክስ አማካይ ተዛምዶን ክትትልን ለማጣት የሚያጋልጡ አስጊ ሁኔታዎችን ለመመርመር፣ እና በፀረ-ኤችአይቪ ሕክምና (ኤአርቲ) ላይ ያሉ ሰዎች የረዥም-ጊዜ ውጤቶችን ለመገምገም የደህንነት ትንታኔን ተጠቀምን።

English: We included 132,274 individuals in our analysis, totalling 270,256 person years of follow up (PYFU; median per patient 1.3, interquartile range (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% were female and the median age was 32 years.
Luganda: Abantu kinnoomu be twateeka mu kwekaliriza kwaffe baali 132,274, omugatte abantu 270,256 mu kulondoola (PYFU); omukkati ku buli mulwadde 1.3, IQR 0.26-3.1, abakazi baali 62% ate omukkati gw’emyaka gwali emyaka 32.
Yoruba: A ṣe àfikún ẹni 132,274 sínú ìsàtúpalẹ̀ wa, tí àpapọ̀ jẹ́ iye ọdún ẹni 270,256 oníkèésí (PYFU; àbọ aláìlera kọ̀ọ̀kan 1.3, ìwọn ìdarin (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% jẹ́ obìnrin bẹ́ẹ̀ àbọ ojọ́orí jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 32.
Zulu: Sifake abantu abayi-132,274 ekuhlaziyeni kwethu, okuhlanganisa iminyaka eyi-270,256 yomuntu yokulandelela (i-PYFU; i-median ngesiguli ngasinye 1.3, i-interquartile range (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% kwakungabesifazane kanti iminyaka emaphakathi yayiyiminyaka engu-32.
Hausa: Mun haɗa da mutane guda 132,274 a cikin bincikenmu, jimlar mutane 270,256 a shekaru masu biyo baya (PYFU; matsakaici ga kowane majiyyaci 1.3, kewayon tsaka-tsaki (IQR) 0.26-3.1), 62% mata ne kuma matsakaicin shekaru shi ne shekaru 32.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra akaretša batho ba 132,274 ka tshekatshekong ya rena, e lego palo yeo e fihlago go palomoka ya batho ba 270,256 mo mengwageng yeo ba tlogo latišišwa ka yona (PYFU; boleng bja magareng ka molwetši 1.3, kelo ya magareng ga dikotaranne (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% e le basadi le ba mengwaga ya magareng ba na le mengwaga ye 32.
Amharic: በእኛ ትንተና ውስጥ 132,274 ግለሰቦችን አካትተናል፣ በድምሩ 270,256 ሰው የአመት ክትትል (PYFU፣ አማካይ በታካሚ 1.3፣ ኢንተርኳርቲል ክልል (IQR) 0.26-3.1)፣ 62% ሴት እና አማካይ ዕድሜ 32 ዓመት ነበር።

English: Retention on ART was lower in the first year on ART compared to subsequent years for all guideline periods and age groups.
Luganda: Okusigala ku bujjanjabi bwa ART kwali wansi mu mwaka gwa ART ogusooka bw’ogeraageranya n’emyaka egiddirira mu biseera ne mu myaka gyonna.
Yoruba: Dídì ART mú ní ọdún àkọ́kọ́ wá sílẹ̀ lóri ART ka wá fiwé àwọn ọdún tó kù fún gbogbo àwọn àkókò ìtọ́sọ́nà àti àwọn ọjọ́ orí.
Zulu: Ukugcinwa kwama-ART kwakuphansi onyakeni wokuqala kuma-ART uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka eyalandela kuzo zonke izikhathi zemihlahlandlela namaqembu eminyaka yobudala.
Hausa: Tsayawa a kan ART ya kasance ƙasa a cikin shekarar farko a kan ART idan aka kwatanta da shekaru masu zuwa don duk lokutan jagora da rukunonin shekaru.
Northern Sotho: Go tšwetšapele ART go bile fase ka ngwaga wa mathomo go ART ge go bapetšwa le menwgaga ye e latelago go dinako ka moka tša ditlhahli le go dihlopha tša mengwaga.
Amharic: በኤአርቲ ላይ ያለው ማቆየት ለሁሉም የመመሪያ ጊዜዎች እና የዕድሜ ቡድኖች ከቀጣዮቹ ዓመታት ጋር ሲነፃፀር ከመጀመሪያው ዓመት ኤአርቲ ዝቅተኛ ነበር።

English: Infants (0–3 years), adolescents and young adults (15–24 years) were at highest risk of LTFU.
Luganda: Abawere (wakati w’emyaka 0-3), abavubuka n’abo abakuzeemu (emyaka 15 - 24) baalina akatyabaga ka waggulu aka LTFU.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọmọ-ọwọ́ (ọmọ ọdún 0–3), àwọn ọ̀dọ́ àti àwọn àgbàlagbà tọ́ ṣì wà lọ́dọ̀ọ́ (ọmọ ọdún 15–24) wọ́n wà nínú ewu ńlá LTFU.
Zulu: Izinsana (iminyaka engu-0-3), intsha kanye nabantu abadala (iminyaka eli-15-24) babesengozini enkulu ye-LTFU.
Hausa: Jarirai (shekaru 0 zuwa 3), samari da matasa (shekaru 15 zuwa 24) sun kasance cikin haɗari mafi girma na LTFU.
Northern Sotho: Masea (mengwaga ye 0–3), bafsa ba mahlalagading le bafsa (ba mengwaga ye 15–24) ba be ba le kotsing ye kglo ya LTFU.
Amharic: ጨቅላ ህፃናት (0-3 አመት)፣ ጎረምሶች እና ወጣት ጎልማሶች (15-24 አመት) ለLTFU ከፍተኛ ተጋላጭነት አላቸው።

English: Comparing the different calendar periods of ART initiation we found that retention improved initially, but remained stable thereafter.
Luganda: Mu kugeraageranya ebiseera by’okutandika ART eby’enjawulo, twazuula ng’okusigala ku bujjanjabi kwalongooka mu kusooka, naye ne kutebenkera mu biseera ebyaddirira.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣàfiwé oríṣiríṣi àwọn àkókó ìdásílẹ̀ kàlẹ́ńdà ART, a ri pé dídìmú gbẹ̀rú si ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ó padà dúro sójú kan lẹ́yìn ìgbà náà.
Zulu: Uma siqhathanisa izikhathi zekhalenda ezihlukene zokuqaliswa kwe-ART sithole ukuthi ukugcinwa kwaba ngcono ekuqaleni, kodwa kwahlala kuzinzile ngemva kwalokho.
Hausa: Ta hanyar kwatanta lokuta daban-daban na kalanda na ƙaddamarwar ART mun gano cewa tsayawar ta inganta da farko, amma ta kasance mai ƙarfi daga baya.
Northern Sotho: Ge g bapetšwa dinako tše di bapanego tša ka khalentareng tša thomišo ya ART re hwweditše gore go tšwetša pele go ile gwa kaonafala mathomong, eupša gwa tšwela pele go ba seemong se tee ka morago ga fao.
Amharic: የተለያዩ የኤአርቲ አጀማመር የቀን መቁጠሪያ ጊዜዎችን በማነፃፀር ማቆየት መጀመሪያ ላይ እንደተሻሻለ፣ ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ የተረጋጋ ሆኖ አግኝተነዋል።

English: Conclusion
Luganda: Okukubira
Yoruba: Ìkádìí
Zulu: Isiphetho
Hausa: Kammalawa

English: Even though the number of patients and the burden on health care system increased substantially during the study period of rapid ART expansion, retention on ART improved in the early years of ART provision, but gains in retention were not maintained over 5 years on ART.
Luganda: Okukubira wadde ng’omuwendo gw’abalwadde n’okunyigiriza ebyobujjanjabi byeyongerera ddala nnyo mu kiseera ky’okunoonyereza kuno okw’okugaziya ART, okubeera ku ddagala lya ART kweyongera mu myaka gy’okufuna ART egyasooka, naye ebibala by’okubeera ku ddagala tebyeyongera mu maaso kusukka myaka 5 egya ART.
Yoruba: Ní ìparí kódà látàrí iye àwọn aláìsàn àti búkàtá ètò ìtọ́jú ìléra ní ìlọsíwájú tó dára lásìkò ìwádìí ART tó gbóòrò, ìdìmú ART gbẹ́rù si ní àwọn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ ọdún tí wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ ART, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò ṣe àmójútó àwọn èrè nínú dídìmú ART ní bí nǹkan bíi ọdún 5.
Zulu: Nakuba inani leziguli kanye nomthwalo ohlelweni lokunakekelwa kwezempilo wenyuka kakhulu ngesikhathi socwaningo lokunwetshwa okusheshayo kwe-ART, ukugcinwa kwe-ART kwaba ngcono eminyakeni yokuqala yokuhlinzekwa kwe-ART, kodwa ukuzuza ekugcineni akuzange kunakekelwe eminyakeni eyi-5 kuma-ART.
Hausa: Kammalawa Ko da yake yawan marasa lafiya da nauyin tsarin kiwon lafiya ya ƙaru sosai a lokacin nazarin binciken gaggawa na faɗaɗa ART, tsayawa a kan ART ya inganta a farkon shekarun samar da ART, amma ba a ci gaba da samun ci gaba a cikin shekaru 5 a kan ART ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore palo ya balwetši le morwalo go lenaneo la tlhokomelo ya maphelo o ile wa oketšega kudu ka nakong ya dinyakišišo ya katološo ye kgolo ya ART, go tšwela pele ka ART go kaonafetše mengwageng ya mathomong ya kabo ya ART, eupša mehola ya go e tšwetša pele ga se ya tšwetšwa pele mo mengwageng ye 5 ya ge ba alfša ka ART.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳን ፈጣን የኤአርቲ መስፋፋት ጥናት ወቅት የታካሚዎች ቁጥር እና በጤና አጠባበቅ ስርዓት ላይ ያለው ሸክም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቢጨምርም፣ በኤአርቲ አቅርቦት የመጀመሪያዎቹ ዓመታት በኤአርቲ ላይ ያለው አያያዝ ተሻሽሏል፣ ነገር ግን በኤአርቲ ላይ በማቆየት ውስጥ የተገኙት ጥቅሞች ከ5 ዓመታት በላይ አልዘለቁም።

Yoruba: Ọ̀nà ṣíṣe ìdíkù tó ga jùlọ ní ọdún kini ART ní láti dúró gẹ́gẹ́ bíi ohun tó pàtàkì jùlọ fún àwọn ètò ART, tí ó sì ní latí sọ bí àwọn ọ̀dọ́, àwọn ọ̀dọ́ lágbàlagbà àti àwọn okùnrin kò ṣe di ètò náà mú dáadáa láàárín wọn.
Zulu: Ukunciphisa ukukhubazeka okuphezulu onyakeni wokuqala we-ART kufanele kuhlale kuseqhulwini ezinhlelweni ze-ART, kanjalo kufanele kubhekwane nokugcinwa okungekuhle phakathi kwentsha, abantu abasha kanye namadoda.

Northern Sotho: Go fokotša kab ya godimo ka ngwaga wa athomo wa go šomiša ART go swanetše go dula e le seo se beilwego pele go mananeo a ART, gomme se se swanetše go direga ge go rarollwa go tšwetša pele fao go fokolago gareng ga bafsa ba mahlalagading, bafsa le banna.

English: Research from Malawi showed that less than half of HIV patients consistently took their anti-HIV medications.

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí láti Malawi fi hàn pé díẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìdáji àwọn aláìsàn HIV ló má ń lo àwọn ògùn tó ń lòdì sí HIV.

English: Researchers said the first 12 months of treatment were critical to instil a pattern of sticking to treatments.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti emyezi 12 egisooka gyali gya nkizo mu kuteekawo embeera y’okusigala ku ddagala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé ìtọ́jú oṣù 12 àkọ́kọ́ jẹ́ èyí tó le láti gbé ìlànà kan kalẹ̀ tó dá lóri kíkọjúmọ́ ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi izinyanga zokuqala eziyi-12 zokwelashwa zazibalulekile ukufaka iphethini yokunamathela ekwelashweni.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun ce watanni 12 na farko na jiyya suna da mahimmanci domin tabbatar da tsarin tsayawa a kan jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dikgwedi tša mathomo tše 12 tša kalafo di be di le bohlokwa go hlama mokgwa wa go tšwela pele ka dihlare.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እንዳሉት የመጀመሪያዎቹ 12 ወራት ህክምናዎች ከህክምናዎች ጋር የመቀጠል ዘይቤን ለማስረጽ በጣም አስፈላጊ ናቸው።

English: They also found that babies and young people were the least likely to return to healthcare providers for follow-ups, so more work was needed to encourage treatment adherence in these groups.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula ng’abawere n’abato be baalina emikisa emitono egiddayo mu bajjanjabi okwongera okwekebejjebwa, ne kiba ng’omulimu munene ogwali gwetaagibwa okukolebwa okusobola okukubiriza abantu abagwa mu bibinja bino okugoberera obujjanjabi obubaweereddwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé àwọn ọmọ ìkókó àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ni àwọn tí ó kẹ́yìn tí ó sì ṣeéṣe kí wọ́n padà sí ọdọ̀ àwọn tí wọ́n ń pèsè ìtójú ìléra fún ìmójútó ohun tí ó kàn, ìdí nìyẹn tí a nílò ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ láti gba àwọn ẹgbẹ́ náà níyànjú láti ma lo ògùn ìtọ́jú wọn.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi abantwana kanye nentsha mancane amathuba okuthi babuyele kubahlinzeki bezempilo ukuze balandelelwe, ngakho-ke kwakudingeka umsebenzi omningi ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambelela ekwelashweni kula maqembu.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun gano cewa jarirai da matasa sun kasance mafi ƙarancin domin komawa ga masu samar da kiwon lafiya domin bin diddigi, don haka, ana buƙatar ƙarin aiki don riƙon jiyya a cikin waɗannan rukunoni.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gape gore masea le bafsa ba be ba le bao go ka kgonagalago gannyane go boela go baabi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo go dira ditatišišo, ka fao go be go hlokega mošomo wo montši go hlohleletša go obamela kalafo ka dihlopheng tše.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ሕፃናት እና ወጣቶች ለክትትል ወደ ጤና አጠባበቅ አቅራቢዎች የመመለስ እድላቸው በጣም አናሳ መሆኑን ደርሰውበታል፣ ስለዚህ በእነዚህ ቡድኖች ውስጥ የሕክምና ጥብቅ ክትትልን ለማበረታታት ተጨማሪ ሥራ ያስፈልጋል።

English: Antiretroviral therapy, or ART, is a combination of HIV medicines used to treat HIV and reduce the spread of the virus.
Luganda: Obujjanjabi bwa mukeenenya, oba ART, mubaamu eddagala lya HIV erikozesebwa okujjanjaba HIV awamu n’okukendeeza ensaasaana y’akawuka.
Yoruba: Tẹ́rápì Antirẹtirováírà, tàbí ART, jẹ́ àkópọ̀ àwọn ògùn HIV tí a nílò láti ṣe ìtọ́jú HIV àti láti dín ìtànkálẹ̀ ààrùn náà kù.
Zulu: Ukwelashwa ngezidambisigciwane, noma i-ART, kuyinhlanganisela yemithi ye-HIV esetshenziselwa ukwelapha.
Hausa: Maganin cutar ƙanjamau, ko ART, haɗin magungunan HIV ne da ake amfani da su domin magance cutar HIV da kuma rage yaɗuwar ƙwayar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Kalafo ka dianthiretherobaerale, goba ka ART, ke motswako wa dihlare tša HIV tšeo di šomišwago go alafa HIV le go fokotša go phatlalala ga baerase.
Amharic: ፀረ-ኤችአይቪ ሕክምና፣ ወይም ኤአርቲ፣ ኤችአይቪን ለማከም እና የቫይረሱን ስርጭት ለመቀነስ የሚያገለግሉ የኤችአይቪ መድኃኒቶች ጥምረት ነው።

English: The World Health Organisation (WHO) says that all HIV patients must take ARTs and it's important to adhere, or stick, to one’s treatment programme.
Luganda: Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi yonna (WHO) kigamba nti abalwadde ba HIV bonna bateekeddwa okukozesa ARTs ate era nga kya mugaso okugoberera, oba okwemaliza ku bujjanjabi bwa kika kimu.
Yoruba: Àjọ Ìléra Àgbáyé (WHO) sọ pé gbogbo àwọn aláìsàn HIV gbọdọ̀ kópa nínú ARTs tí ó sì ṣe kókó láti faramọ́, tàbí dúró lóri ètò ìtọ́jú kan.
Zulu: INhlangano Yezempilo Yamazwe (WHO) ithi zonke iziguli ezine-HIV kufanele zithathe imishanguzo futhi kubalulekile ukulandela, noma ukunamathela, ohlelweni lomuntu lokwelapha.
Hausa: Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta ce dole ne duk masu cutar HIV su karɓi ARTs kuma yana da mahimmanci a bi, ko kuma su tsaya a kan tsarin jiyyarsu.
Northern Sotho: Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase (WHO) o bolela gore balwetši ka moka ba HIV ba swanetše go nwa di-ART le gore go bhlokwa go obamela, goba go tšwela pele, ka lenaneo la kalafo le tee.
Amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት (WHO) ሁሉም የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች ኤአርቲዎችን መውሰድ አለባቸው እና ለአንድ ሰው የህክምና ፕሮግራሙን በጥብቅ መከተል፣ ወይም መቀጠል፣ አስፈላጊ ነው ብሏል።

English: In this study, researchers wanted to find out how long HIV patients in Malawi tend to stay on their ARTs, and they wanted to see which age groups would most likely be at risk for not following through on the treatment programme.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula ebbanga abalwadde ba HIV mu ggwanga lya Malawi lye batera okumala nga bakyakozesa ARTs, ate era nga baagala n’okumanya emyaka gy’abantu abayinza okusinga okuba mu katyabaga olw’obutagoberera nteekateeka ya bujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ wádìí bí ó ṣe pẹ́ àwọn aláìsàn HIV sí ní Malawi làti dúró lóri ARTs wọn, tí wọ́n sì fẹ́ rí àwọn ọjọ́ orí tí ó ṣeéṣe kí wọ́n ní ìjàm̀bá látàrí àìṣe ìmójútó èto ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuthola ukuthi iziguli ezine-HIV eMalawi zivame ukuhlala isikhathi eside kangakanani kuma-ART azo, futhi babefuna ukubona ukuthi yimaphi amaqembu eminyaka angaba sengozini yokungalandeli uhlelo lokwelashwa.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun so su gano tsawon lokacin da masu cutar HIV a ƙasar Malawi sukan kasance a kan ARTs, kuma suna so su ga waɗanne rukunonin shekaru ne da za su kasance cikin haɗari domin rashin bin tsarin kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka g tseba gore ba lwetši ba HIV ka Malawi ba tšea lebaka le lekaakang ba tšwela pele ka di-ART, gomme ba be ba nyaka go bona gore ke dihlopha dife tša mengwaga tšeo go bego go na le kgonagalo ye kglo ya gore di ka ba kotsing ya go se latela lenaneo la kalafo.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ፣ ተመራማሪዎች በማላዊ ውስጥ ያሉ የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች ለምን ያህል ጊዜ በኤአርቲዎች ላይ እንደሚቆዩ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፣ እና የትኞቹ የዕድሜ ቡድኖች የሕክምና ፕሮግራሙን ያለመከተል ስጋት ላይ እንደሚወድቁ ለማየት ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They did a cohort study, which is a type of study that monitors a group of people over time.
Luganda: Baakola okunoonyereza kw’oluyingiza, nga kuno kwe kunoonyereza okulondoola ekibinja ky’abantu abamu okumala ebbanga.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí ẹlẹ́gbẹ́jẹgbẹ́, tí ó sì jẹ́ irú ìwádìí tí ó ń ṣe àmójútó àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn ní àwọn àkókò kan.
Zulu: Benza ucwaningo lweqembu, okuwuhlobo locwaningo oluqapha iqembu labantu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
Hausa: Sun yi nazari na rukunoni, wanda wani nau’i ne na binciken da ake sa-ido a kan rukunin mutane a tsawon lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile dinyakišišo tša go akaretša sehlopha sa batho lebaka le letelele, e lego mohuta wa dinyakišišo wo o hlokometšego sehlopha sa batho lebaka le letelele.
Amharic: የሰዎች ስብስብ ቡድን በጊዜ ሂደት የሚከታተል የጥናት አይነት የሆነውን፣ የተመሳሳይ ሰዎች ቡድን ጥናትን አደረጉ።

English: They looked at patients from hospitals or clinics in central and southern Malawi, from 2000 to 2015, and they used statistics to predict the risk of patients stopping their treatment programme.
Luganda: Baatunuulira abalwadde okuva mu malwaliro oba obulwaliro obusangibwa mu masekkati ne mu bukiikaddyo bwa Malawi, okuva mu mwaka gwa 2000 okutuuka mu 2015, era ne bakozesa ebibalo okuteebereza akatyabaga abalwadde ke balina nga balekedde awo okukozesa eddagala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wọ àwọn aláìsàn láti àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn tó wà ní àárín àti apá gúsù Malawi, láti ọdún 2000 sí 2015, tí wọ́n sì lo ìṣirò ọ̀hún láti sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ìjàm̀bá tó ma ṣẹlẹ̀ sí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n bá dá ètò ìtọ́jú wọn dúró.
Zulu: Babheka iziguli ezivela ezibhedlela noma emitholampilo emaphakathi naseningizimu yeMalawi, kusukela ngowe-2000 kuya kowe-2015, futhi basebenzisa izibalo ukubikezela ubungozi beziguli eziyeka uhlelo lwazo lokwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun duba majiyyata daga asibitoci ko ɗakunan shan magani a tsakiya da kuma kudancin ƙasar Malawi, daga shekarar 2000 zuwa shekarar 2015, kuma sun yi amfani da ƙididdiga domin yin hasashen haɗarin da majiyyata da suka dakatar da shirinsu na jiyya za su iya fuskanta.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lebelela balwetši g tšwa ka dipetlele goba ka dikliniking ka bogareng le borwa bja Malawi, go thoma ka ngwaga wa 2000 go fihla ka 2015, gomme ba ile ba šomiša dipalopalo go akanya kotsi ya balwetši bao ba emišago lenaneo la bona la kalafo.
Amharic: ከ2000 እስከ 2015፣ በማእከላዊ እና በደቡብ ማላዊ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሆስፒታሎች ወይም ክሊኒኮች ታማሚዎችን ተመልክተዋል፣ እና ታማሚዎች የህክምና ፕሮግራማቸውን ሊያቆሙ የሚችሉበትን ስጋት ለመተንበይ ስታቲስቲክሱን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: They studied 132 274 patients in total.
Luganda: Beekaliriza abalwadde bonna awamu 132,274.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí 132 274 àwọn aláìsàn ní àpapọ̀.
Zulu: Bacwaninge iziguli eziyi-132 274 sezizonke.
Hausa: Sun yi nazarin gabaɗaya majiyyata guda 132 274.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba nyakišiša ka ga palomoka ya balwetši ba 132 274.
Amharic: በጠቅላላው 132 274 ታካሚዎችን አጥንተዋል።

English: The average age of starting ARTs was 32.5 years old, and more than half of the patients were female.
Luganda: Omukkati gw’emyaka gy’okutandika ARTs gwali ku myaka 32.5, ate era ettundutundu erisinga obunene ery’abalwadde baali bakyala.
Yoruba: Ggbèdéke ọjọ́ orí láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ARTs jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 32.5, àti pẹ́ àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ju ìlàjì lọ ni wọ́n  jẹ́ obìnrin.
Zulu: Isilinganiso seminyaka yobudala bokuqala ama-ART sasiyiminyaka engama-32.5, futhi ngaphezu kwesigamu seziguli kwakungabesifazane.
Hausa: Matsakaicin shekarun fara ARTs shi ne shekaru 32.5, kuma fiye da rabin majiyyatan mata ne.
Northern Sotho: Mengwaga ya magareng ya go thomiša ka di- ART e bile mengwaga ye 32.5, gomme palo ya go feta seripagare sa balwetši e be e le basadi.
Amharic: ኤአርቲዎችን የሚጀምሩበት አማካይ ዕድሜ 32.5 ዓመት ሲሆን፣ ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑት ታካሚዎች ሴቶች ናቸው።

English: They found that only 46% of the patients stayed on their ART program, 16% had switched to another program, 37% were lost during follow-ups and less than 1% stopped the treatment altogether.
Luganda: Baazuula ng’ebitundu 46% byokka eby’abalwadde be baasigala ku nteekateeeka ya ART, ebitundu 16% baali bagivuddeko ne badda ku nteekateeka endala, ebitundu 37% baabula mu kiseera ky’okwekebejjebwa okw’oluvannyuma ate era ng’abalwadde abatawera kitundu 1% baali tebakyakozesa bujjanjabi bwonna.
Yoruba: Wọn ri pe ida 46% awọn alaisan nikan lo duro lori eto ART wọn, ida 16% ti yi lọ si eto miiran, ida 37% ti ṣọnu lasiko ti wọn ṣe imojuto ohun ti o kan ati pẹ diẹ ninu ida 1% ti da gbogbo itọju wọn duro.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi ama-46% kuphela eziguli ezihlale ohlelweni lwazo lwemishanguzo, ama-16% ashintshele kolunye uhlelo, ama-37% alahleka ngesikhathi kuhlolwa futhi angaphansi kwe-1% ayeka ngokuphelele ukwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa kawai kashi 46% na marasa lafiya ne suka tsaya a kan shirinsu na ART, kashi 16% sun canza zuwa wani shirin, kashi 37% sun ɓace a yayin bibiya kuma ƙasa da kashi 1% sun dakatar da maganin gabaɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore ke fela balwetši ba 46% bao ba tšwetšego pele ka lenaneo la bona la ART, 16% yona e fetogetše go lenaneo le lengwe, 37% ba ile ba lahlega ka nakng ya tatišišo gomme palo ya ka fase ga 1% e ile ya emiša kalafo ka moka.
Amharic: ከታካሚዎቹ ውስጥ 46%ቱ ብቻ በ ART ፕሮግራም ላይ እንደቆዩ፣ 16%ቱ ወደ ሌላ ፕሮግራም እንደተሸጋገሩ፣ 37%ቱ በክትትሎች ወቅት እንደጠፉ እና ከ 1% በታች የሚሆኑት ህክምናውን ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዳቆሙ አረጋግጠዋል።

English: They noticed that after 12 months of starting their ART programmes, many patients stopped taking their medication.
Luganda: Baazuula ng’abalwadde bangi baalekera awo okumira eddagala lyabwe oluvannyuma lw’emyezi 12 nga batandise enteekateeka zaabwe eza ART.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sàkíyèsí pé lẹ́yìn oṣù 12 tí wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ètò ART wọn, púpọ̀ nínú àwọn aláìsàn dá lílo àwọn ogun wọn dúró.
Zulu: Baqaphela ukuthi ngemva kwezinyanga eziyi-12 ziqale izinhlelo zazo ze-ART, iziguli eziningi zayeka ukuphuza imithi yazo.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa bayan watanni 12 na fara shirye-shiryensu na ART, yawancin majiyyata sun daina shan magungunansu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoga gore ka morago ga dikgwedi tše 12 tša ge ba thomišitše ka mananeo a ART, balwetši ba bantši ba ile ba emiša go nwa dihlare tša bona.
Amharic: የኤአርቲ ፕሮግራሞቻቸውን ከጀመሩ ከ12 ወራት በኋላ፣ ብዙ ታካሚዎች መድሃኒቶቻቸውን እንዳቆሙ አስተውለዋል።

English: They showed that women are more likely to return to the hospital for their follow-ups compared to men.
Luganda: Baalaga nti abakyala balina emikisa mingi okudda mu ddwaliro okwongera okwekebejjebwa bw’ogeraageranya n’abasajja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi hàn pé ó ṣeéṣe kí àwọn obìnrin padà sí ilé ìwòsàn fún àwọn ohun tó kàn jú ka fi wé àwọn okùnrin lọ.
Zulu: Bakhombise ukuthi abesifazane maningi amathuba okuthi babuyele esibhedlela ukuze balandelelwe uma kuqhathaniswa nabesilisa.
Hausa: Sun nuna cewa mata sun fi komawa asibiti don bibiyars u idan aka kwatanta su da maza.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba laetša gore basadi go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo go bela sepetlele go ya go latišišwa ge go bapetšw ale banna.
Amharic: ሴቶች ከወንዶች ጋር ሲነፃፀሩ ለክትትላቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል የመመለስ እድላቸው ሰፊ መሆኑን አሳይተዋል።

English: Patients aged 0-2 years and 15-24 years had the highest risk of not returning for their follow-ups.
Luganda: Abalwadde abali wakati w’emyaka 0-2 awamu n’abo abali wakati w’emyaka 15-24 be baalina akatyabaga aka waggulu ak’obutaddayo kwongera kwekebejjebwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn tí ọjọ́ orí wọn wà ní ọmọ ọdún 0-2 àti àwọn tí ọjọ́ orí wọn wà ní ọmọ ọdún 15-24 ní gbèdéke tó pọ̀jù lọ láti padà fún mímójútó àwọn ohun tó kàn.
Zulu: Iziguli ezineminyaka eyi-0-2 kanye neminyaka eyi-15-24 zazinengozi enkulu kakhulu yokungabuyi ukuze zilandelelwe.
Hausa: Majiyyata masu shekaru 0 zuwa 2 da kuma shekaru 15 zuwa 24 sun fi haɗarin rashin dawowa don bibiyar su.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba mengwaga ye 0-2 le ba mengwaga ye 15-24 ba bile kotsing ya godimodimo ya go boela go tatišišo ya bona.
Amharic: ዕድሜያቸው ከ0-2 ዓመት እና ከ15-24 ዓመት የሆኑ ታካሚዎች ለክትትሎቻቸው ያለመመለስ ከፍተኛ አደጋ ነበራቸው።

English: They also noticed that if a patient started ARTs at 35 years or older, they will most likely return for their follow-up appointments.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula nga singa omulwadde yatandika ARTs ku myaka 35 oba okusingawo, baalina emikisa mingi okuddayo okwongera okwekebejjebwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàkíyèsí pé tí aláìsàn kan bá bẹ̀rẹ̀ ARTs ní ọmọ ọdún 35 tàbí jú bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ, ó ṣeéṣe kí wọ́n padà fún àwọn ìpàdé mímójútó ohun tó kàn.
Zulu: Baphinde baqaphela ukuthi uma isiguli siqala imishanguzo yesifo sengculaza sineminyaka engama-35 noma ngaphezulu, cishe sizobuya ukuze sizolandelelwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma lura cewa idan majiyyaci ya fara ARTs a shekaru 35 ko sama da haka, za su iya komawa domin alƙawuran sake ganin likita da suka biyo baya.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoga gape gore ge e le gore  molwetši o thomišitše ka di-ARTs ge  a na le mengwaga ye 35 goba go feta, go na le kgonagalo ye kglo ya gore a ka boela dipeelanong tša gago tša tatišišo.
Amharic: እንዲሁም አንድ ታካሚ በ35 አመት እና ከዚያ በላይ ኤአርቲስ ከጀመረ፣ ለቀጣይ የክትትል ቀጠሮዎቻቸው ሊመለሱ እንደሚችሉ አስተውለዋል።

English: Other studies have shown that HIV patients must stay on their ART programmes for it to be effective, and many researchers noticed younger patients don't adhere to treatment regiments in some parts of the world.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okulala kulaze nti abalwadde ba HIV bateekeddwa okusigala ku nteeketeeka zaabwe eza ART okusobola okukola obulungi, ate abanoonyereza bangi baazuula ng’abalwadde abato mu myaka tebagoberera biragiro bya bujjanjabi mu bitundu by’ensi ebimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwádìí tí ó kù ti fi hàn pé àwọn aláìsàn HIV ní láti dúró lóri ètò ART wọn kí ó ba lè ní ipa tó múnádóko, àti pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàkíyèsí pé àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tó jẹ́ aláìsàn wọn kìí tẹ̀lẹ́ àwọn ìlànà ìtọ́jú ní àwọn apá ibìkan lágbàáyé.
Zulu: Olunye ucwaningo luye lwabonisa ukuthi iziguli ze-HIV kufanele zihlale ezinhlelweni zazo ze-ART ukuze isebenze kahle, futhi abacwaningi abaningi baqaphela ukuthi iziguli ezisencane azilandeli izigaba zokwelapha kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba.
Hausa: Sauran bincike sun nuna cewa masu cutar HIV dole ne su kasance a kan shirye-shiryensu na ART domin yin aiki, kuma masu bincike da yawa sun lura da ƙananan marasa lafiya ba sa bin tsarin kulawa a wasu sassan duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše dingwe di laeditše gore balwetši ba HIV ba swanetše go tšwela pele ka mananeo a bona a  ART gore e kgone go šoma, gomme banyakišiši ba bantši ba ile ba lemoga gore balwetši bao e lego bafsa ga ba obamele go nwa dihlare tša bona ka dikarlong tše dingwe tša lefase.
Amharic: ሌሎች ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች የኤአርቲ ፕሮግራሞቻቸው ውጤታማ እንዲሆኑ እነሱ ላይ መቆየት አለባቸው፣ እና ብዙ ተመራማሪዎች በአንዳንድ የአለም ክፍሎች ውስጥ ያሉ ወጣት ታካሚዎች የሕክምና ስርዓተ-ሰልፎችን በጥብቅ እንደማይከተሉ አስተውለዋል።

English: This study confirms the same trend in parts of Malawi.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kukakasa ensonga eno mu bitundu bya Malawi.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí jẹ́rìí sí irú rẹ̀ ní àwọn apá ibìkan ní Malawi.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luqinisekisa ukuthambekela okufanayo ezingxenyeni zaseMalawi.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya tabbatar da irin wannan yanayin a sassan ƙasar Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di tiišetša seemo se se swanago ka dikarolong tša ka Malawi.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በማላዊ ክፍሎች ውስጥ ተመሳሳይ አዝማሚያን ያረጋግጣል።

English: The researchers caution however that their study may have some limitations.
Luganda: Wabula, abanoonyereza balabula nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kuyinza okuba n’obunafu obumu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí ṣọ́ra síbẹ̀síbẹ̀ ìwádìí wọn léè ní àwọn ìdílọ́wọ́ kànkan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayisa nokho ukuthi ucwaningo lwabo lungaba nemikhawulo ethile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa binciken nasu na iya samun wasu iyakoki.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši le ge go le bjale ba lemošitše gore dinyakišišo tša bona di ka ba le mellwane.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግን ጥናታቸው የተወሰነ ገደብ ሊኖረው እንደሚችል ያስጠነቅቃሉ።

English: They said some of the hospitals they studied used electronic systems to record the patients, and it seemed like these hospitals had more patients who didn’t return for their follow-ups.
Luganda: Baagamba nti agamu ku malwaliro ge beekaliriza gaali gakozesa miyungo gya tekinologiya okusobola okuyingiza obubaka obukwata ku balwadde, ate era nga kyalabika ng’amalwaliro gano gaalina abalwadde bangi abataakomawo kwongera kwekalirizibwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn kan tí wọ́n ṣe ìwádíì wọn  ń lo ẹ̀rọ ẹlẹ́tíróníkì láti ṣe ìgbàsílẹ̀ àwọn aláìsàn, ó sì jọ pé àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn yìí ní àwọn aláìsàn tó pọ̀ tí wọn kò padà wá fún ìṣàmójútó ohun tí ó kàn.
Zulu: Bathe ezinye zezibhedlela abazicwaninga zisebenzisa amasistimu kagesi ukuqopha iziguli, futhi kubonakala sengathi lezi zibhedlela zineziguli eziningi ezingabuyanga ukuzolandelelwa.
Hausa: Sun ce wasu asibitocin da suka yi nazari sun yi amfani da na’urorin lantarki wajen naɗar bayanan majiyyatan, kuma ga dukkan alamu waɗannan asibitocin suna da majiyyata da yawa waɗanda ba su dawo domin bibiyar su ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dipetlele tše dingwe tše ba nyakišišitšego ka tšona di šomišitše mananeo a elektroniki go gatiša balwetši, gomme go bonala e ke dipetlele tše di be di na le balwetši ba bantši bao ba seg ba boela go ditatišišo tša bona.
Amharic: ያጠኑዋቸው አንዳንድ ሆስፒታሎች ታካሚዎችን ለመመዝገብ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ሲስተሞችን ተጠቅመዋል፣ እናም እነዚህ ሆስፒታሎች ለክትትላቸው የማይመለሱ ብዙ ታማሚዎች ያሏቸው ይመስላል።

English: Also, of the patients who didn’t return, some could have died or transferred to other programmes without telling anyone.
Luganda: N’ekirala, mu balwadde abataakomawo, abamu bayinza okuba nga baafa oba nga badda ku nteekateeka endala nga tebalina muntu yenna gwe bategeezezza.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn kò padà, àwọn mìíràn léè ti kú tàbí kí wọ́n ti kọrí sí àwọn ètò mìíràn láì sọ fún ẹníkankan.
Zulu: Futhi, ezigulini ezingabuyanga, ezinye kungabe zashona noma zadluliselwa kwezinye izinhlelo ngaphandle kokutshela muntu.
Hausa: Haka nan, ga majiyyatas da ba su dawo ba, wasu suna iya mutuwa ko canja wuri zuwa wasu shirye-shirye ba tare da gaya wa kowa ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape, go balwetši bao ba sego ba boela go ditatišišo tša bona, ba bangwe ba ka be ba hlokofetše goba ba ile ba fetišetšwa g mananeo a mangwe ka ntle le go botša motho yo mongwe.
Amharic: እንዲሁም፣ ካልተመለሱት ታካሚዎች አንዳንዶቹ ሊሞቱ ወይም ለማንም ሳይናገሩ ወደ ሌሎች ፕሮግራሞች ሊተላለፉ ይችላሉ።

English: The study also relied on people collecting the data regularly, and there could have been some mistakes when recording the information.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza era kwesigama ku bantu okuba nga bakuŋŋaanya obubaka buli lunaku, era nga wayinza okuba nga waliwo ensobi ezaakolebwa nga bawandiika obubaka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí tún gbáralé àwọn tí wọ́n ń gba àwọn dátà náà déédé, àti pé àwọn àṣìṣe kànkan léè ti wà nígbà tí wọ́n ń ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn ìròyìn náà.
